positive_terms: Disclosure of specification of impacts, risks and opportunities that are covered by ESRS Disclosure Requirements as opposed to those covered by additional entity-specific disclosures
标准覆盖与企业特有事项区分

Disclosure of specification of impacts, risks and opportunities that are covered by ESRS Disclosure Requirements as opposed to those covered by additional entity-specific disclosures。标准覆盖与企业特有事项区分。影响与财务风险机会分开，当前与未来财务效果分开；集团业务背景不自动适用于子公司或特定场址。
